title: Tien_Phase_5_3_Day_Weeks_1-4_Boostcamp
author: Tien N.
desc:
Build consistency and momentum with this three-day-per-week training program.  
Across four weeks, follow a manageable schedule designed to fit around a busy life.  
Show up, train with purpose, and make each session count.  
A straightforward option for lifters ready to commit to a regular routine.

ex.note: Curl pelvis toward ribs; slow lowering. Add load only after 3x15 clean. · Baseline: record load + reps
Start ~250-255 lb if recovered; controlled descent; maintain 6+ reps. · Baseline: record load + reps
Last benchmark 205 lb x 6-7; full overhead stretch. · Baseline: record load + reps
Keep cable fly, not pec deck; hug toward midline, no forced crossover. · Baseline: record load + reps
~70 lb prior baseline; keep torso stable. · Baseline: record load + reps
Do before hammer curls; ~25 lb prior baseline. · Baseline: record load + reps
Strict shoulder-width focus; no momentum. · Baseline: record load + reps
~80 lb x15x3 last session; progress gradually. · Baseline: record load + reps

Recurring one-sided lower-abdominal pressure: seek clinical assessment before heavy hack squats. Use symptom-free alternative meanwhile. · DO NOT load heavy until assessed; choose symptom-free substitute
~770 lb previous; only if no abdominal pressure; otherwise substitute comfortable quad exercise. · Baseline: record load + reps

~205 lb prior; controlled top squeeze. · Baseline: record load + reps
Full stretch, pause at top; ~330 lb x15x3 prior. · Baseline: record load + reps
~100 lb previous; add reps before load. · Baseline: record load + reps

Controlled, no swinging. · Baseline: record load + reps
~85 lb prior baseline; own range before increasing. · Baseline: record load + reps
